analysis.title: Senior Automation Engineer (Python, AI Agents & Automation)
analysis.fit_rationale: Strong alignment in Python automation, API integration, CI/CD, and AI-assisted workflows. Candidate has deep Python/Pandas ETL experience, AI-assisted development (Copilot, Claude Code), and hands-on agentic AI projects (job-search pipeline with MCP, lakehouse with Text-to-SQL). However, the role emphasizes production-grade automation for documentation/localization, which is not a direct match. Candidate's experience is more in capacity/performance engineering and data pipelines, with some automation but not at the scale or domain specificity required. Gaps in multi-agent orchestration, observability for AI systems, and containerization of long-running services.
strengths: Expert-level Python and ETL design, with production experience building pipelines (CITI P95 telemetry).
Strong AI-assisted development: uses Copilot, Claude Code, and has built agentic workflows (job-search pipeline with MCP, lakehouse with Text-to-SQL).
Experience with REST APIs and integrating multiple data sources (JIRA, SQL Server, Splunk).
CI/CD familiarity: Git-based workflows, GitHub Actions (implied by pipeline project).
Mentoring and cross-functional collaboration from senior roles.
Proven ability to automate reporting and reduce manual effort (capacity reports).
gaps: No direct experience in documentation, localization, or content operations automation.
Limited evidence of designing multi-agent or tool-orchestrated AI workflows at scale; pipeline is personal project.
No demonstrated experience with observability, metrics, or cost tracking for AI-driven automation.
No containerization or deployment of long-running agent services in production.
Role requires flexibility for late afternoon meetings; candidate location (Murphy, TX) is Central time, which is acceptable but not Eastern.
Candidate's AI projects are personal or research, not enterprise production deployments.
tailoring_plan: Tailor resume to emphasize automation engineering aspects: highlight Python automation projects, AI agent design (pipeline, lakehouse), and API integrations. Use keywords from job description: 'production-grade automation', 'agent frameworks', 'MCP', 'REST APIs', 'CI/CD', 'GitHub Actions'. Frame capacity reporting as automation of manual processes. Add a section on AI-assisted engineering tools (Copilot, Claude Code) and responsible AI practices. Address gaps by mentioning any experience with documentation or content workflows, even if tangential. Emphasize flexibility for global collaboration
